description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces and functions for managing network tunnels using ngrok and Tailscale, including starting, stopping, and checking availability.

methods.name: startNgrokTunnel
methods.description: Starts an ngrok tunnel with specified configuration, returning a TunnelResult object.

methods.name: runNgrokCommand
methods.description: Executes an ngrok CLI command and returns its output.

methods.name: isNgrokAvailable
methods.description: Checks if ngrok is installed and available on the system.

methods.name: startTailscaleTunnel
methods.description: Starts a Tailscale tunnel in serve or funnel mode.

methods.name: stopTailscaleTunnel
methods.description: Stops a Tailscale tunnel in serve or funnel mode.

methods.name: startTunnel
methods.description: Starts a tunnel based on provided configuration, selecting ngrok or Tailscale.
